scope: Static trace of existing normal observation loop and cleanup; no synthetic or real process execution.

identities.L: direct Popen leader, PID and PGID L
identities.C: new descendant, PID C, inherited PGID L, remains alive

steps.event: process_rows returns only L in the owned group; anchors receives L; process.returncode is None
L forks C, then L exits; C has never appeared in an anchor snapshot
proc.poll reaps L and sets its returncode
refreshed process_rows contains C in PGID L; anchors still contains only L
reaped leader selects signal_group; C is not anchored, L is gone; RuntimeError occurs before os.killpg
group exists, so exceptional stop_owned runs with already-reaped L and anchors containing only L
both send callbacks reject unproven C; errors are recorded; waits cannot restore L ownership; C remains alive
failure receipt reports group absence false; controller can return failure with live owned C

not_claimed: Accepted worker actually created this descendant
contract: Requested independent owned-group cancellation, TERM/KILL/reap and bounded cleanup include surviving same-group descendants.
